title: Write descriptions for the first useful read
question: automatic activation
prompt: Help me revise this agent-skill description: `Use for sustained collaborative exploration before or during consequential work.` The skill should become available when a user is brainstorming, comparing approaches, shaping an idea, giving an open-ended request, or reopening assumptions after new evidence. Write a concise replacement and explain what makes it a reliable activation description for an agent that has not read the skill body yet.

assertions.rubric: The replacement description must use plain, observable situations available before the body is read, such as brainstorming, comparing approaches, shaping an idea, an open-ended request, or reopened assumptions. It must not depend on unexplained classifications such as `sustained` or `consequential` to decide whether to load the skill.

The explanation must optimize for the earliest useful activation, distinguish description routing from body-level classification, and allow a nearby prompt either not to activate or to load safely without hijacking the task.
